## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman who features a softly-triangular face with pink cheeks and large, soft blue eyes. She styles her snow-white hair in quaint little puffs over her ears.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is described as the sweetest aunt who possesses a proper respect for the clergy. Looking ahead to the afterlife, her desire is to wear a yellow silk dress in heaven.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

## History

Aunt Jamesina was named after her father, James, who tragically drowned at sea a month before she was born. Though she never attended college herself, she moved into Patty's Place to serve as an easygoing chaperone for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her fellow female students. She brought along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), who eventually adjusted to living alongside the students' resident stray cat. Throughout her time chaperoning at Patty's Place, Aunt Jamesina shared her life wisdom, reflected with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on growing older, and discussed past suitors as well as Phil's romantic developments. She also shared in the living arrangements when the girls learned they could retain Patty's Place for an additional year. Following the girls' college graduation, Aunt Jamesina gathered with them at Patty's Place to unwind before they packed up to leave the house for good.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +24 more_

## Quotes

> "She couldn’t take Joseph with her so she begged me to take him. I really couldn’t refuse. He’s a beautiful cat—that is, his disposition is beautiful. She called him Joseph because his coat is of many colors."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> “I suppose you feel kind of, sorry” said Aunt Jamesina. “The teens are such a nice part of life. I’m glad I’ve never gone out of them myself.”
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)
